name: Hamby Freestyle Jiu Jitsu
evidence: Rebrand at the identical unit: 2231 Dawson Rd STE K, Albany, GA 31707 (Hamby occupied 2231 Dawson Rd Ste K/L). Site body still carries a Hamby-era testimonial ("you won't regret trying Hamby out"). Named Adult/Kids/No-Gi BJJ classes on its own pages. Old hambyfreestyle.com is NXDOMAIN.

name: Ruff House Boxing and MMA
evidence: ruffhouseboxing.com and www.ruffhouseboxing.com are both NXDOMAIN (Status 3). The alternate ruffhousemma.com resolves but lands on a HugeDomains for-sale lander. A facebook.com/ruffhousemma page exists but bjjmetrics attributes that handle to a Texas gym, so it is probably a different business. No school-owned page found; 4111A Robinson St NW appears only in directories.

name: Gracie Barra Gainesville
evidence: 2197 Dawsonville Hwy Suite B, Gainesville, GA 30506 / 678-943-8228 read in the body of the official Gracie Barra school subsite. Old gbgainesville.com is NXDOMAIN. Caveat: Yelp marks this listing CLOSED, but GB corporate still serves an active school page with school-specific hours.

name: Macon Jiu Jitsu Academy
evidence: No live domain. maconjiujitsu.com is NXDOMAIN, and maconjiujitsu.academy (the URL chamberofcommerce.com asserts) is also NXDOMAIN. Address 3258 Vineville Ave / 478-207-7485 appears only in third-party directories, which I did not treat as sources.

name: Fit to Fight Georgia
evidence: No school-owned site. fittofight.com/locations lists only Charlotte NC and Gastonia NC; Statesboro is an unlisted affiliate with no page. Sole web presence found is facebook.com/FitToFightGA. Listed address 1263 S&S Railroad Bed Trail comes from third-party directories only. Also note the brand is Krav Maga self-defense, so grappling scope is unverified.

name: EDS Martial Arts and Self-Defense School
evidence: No site for the Bloomingdale unit. elitejkd.com (Elite Defense Systems) resolves but its body covers Rockford only - tagline "Rockford karate, Rockford martial arts", and its contact form offers solely "Youth/Men's/Women's Classes (Rockford Area)". 215 E Lake St Bloomingdale appears nowhere on it, and it lists no BJJ or grappling class (Kids Karate and JKD self-defense only). freeself-defense.com, the URL directories assert, resolves to an empty LiteSpeed "Index of /" containing just a cgi-bin folder.

name: GB Evanston
evidence: Official Gracie Barra school subsite for Evanston: phone 847-730-4163 and "Evanston, IL 60201" in the page body, with school-specific hours (Sun closed, Fri 8:30-10:30am). GB publishes no street address for this school. Named GB1/GB2/GBK Jiu-Jitsu class pages under the same subsite.

name: GB Jacksonville
evidence: No fetchable site. graciebarra.com has no jacksonville-il subsite: /jacksonville-il/contact-us/ redirects to the national graciebarra.com/contact-us/. gbjacksonville.com is the Jacksonville FLORIDA school (8210 Cypress Plaza Dr) - wrong entity. gbjacksonvilleil.com is NXDOMAIN. Only candidate left is facebook.com/p/Gracie-Jiu-Jitsu-Jacksonville-100057261138859/ (915 W Superior St per listings), which web_fetch cannot render.

name: Constrictor MMA
evidence: theconstrictormma.com is NXDOMAIN (Status 3), even though search engines still serve indexed pages from it (theconstrictormma.com/shop/, /constrictorlogo/). No other domain found. 1245 N Green St / (224) 628-5028 appear only in ClassPass, Yelp and WellnessLiving listings.

name: RMNU Rockton Judo & Jiu Jitsu Academy
evidence: HOSTILE HIJACK. rmnurockton.org - the school's former domain per directory listings - resolves and renders a WordPress SEO content farm titled "Healthy Outlets for Frustration" carrying paid links to a Brisbane escort directory. No jiu-jitsu, judo or Rockton content remains. rmnurockton.com is NXDOMAIN.

name: Fight Camp Nv
evidence: No domain exists: fightcampnv.com and carsoncitycombatacademy.com are both NXDOMAIN. Sole web presence is facebook.com/fightcampnv, which now displays under the name "Carson City Combat Academy" (possible rebrand) and which web_fetch cannot render. Grappling scope unverified.

evidence: samuraitc.com is registered (GoDaddy nameservers) but returns Status 0 with NO A record at the apex, and www.samuraitc.com is NXDOMAIN. samuraitrainingcenter.org, the successor URL directories cite, is also NXDOMAIN.
